commit.message:
feat(sim): judge fixture collisions against the fixture's real mesh

The world-AABB fixture laws (c2)/(d2) stay the broad phase; a tagged
model's closed world mesh now gets the last word on every upright move
its box flagged, and may only acquit. A path down a vise's gap - inside
its one box, nowhere near its steel - posts and generates clean, while
a jaw-corner clip, a rapid into a jaw top, a holder over a jaw and a
tool buried in steel still block the post.

Narrow phase (camcraft_sim::fixture_mesh): each band of the stack is an
upright cylinder swept along the tip's chord - a convex Minkowski sum -
tested against facets by GJK, "clear" only on a proven support-plane gap
over FIXTURE_HIT_TOL (+ the arc chord's deviation); a band clear of
every facet is decided wholly inside/outside by ray-crossing winding +
parity with ambiguity rejection. Object-median AABB BVH, pruned by the
same proof. Open, non-finite, collapsed or oversized meshes refuse by
name (MeshError) and keep the box verdict; posed, C-turned, XZ/YZ-arc
moves and lathe tools keep the box verdict. Where nothing is acquitted
the report is the box laws' own, byte for byte.

Refs #339
